output.answer_markdown: PepsiCo increased its unsecured five-year revolving credit agreement by $400 million, from $3.8 billion (the 2022 Five Year Credit Agreement, terminated effective May 26, 2023) to $4.2 billion (the new 2023 Five Year Credit Agreement entered into May 26, 2023) [3].
